definitions.gloss: rain shoes; rain boots; waterproof footwear
definitions.explanation: Waterproof shoes or boots worn in the rain, of any height. {雨|あめ} becomes あま in the compound, as in {雨傘|あまがさ} and {雨宿|あまやど}り.

examples.japanese: {雨靴|あまぐつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}く→履く：00700_haku⟧。
⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧{雨靴|あまぐつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought rain shoes for the rainy season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧{雨靴|あまぐつ}なら、⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{履|は}いて→履く：00700_haku⟧いけて⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: Short rain shoes are handy because you can wear them for commuting too.

notes:
Covers any waterproof footwear for rain, from ankle-high rain shoes to tall boots. Shops today often say レイン⟦シューズ→シューズ：10962_shuuzu⟧ or レイン⟦ブーツ→ブーツ：04529_buutsu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雨靴|あまぐつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}いて→履く：00700_haku⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧: to go out in rain boots
- {子|こ}ども⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雨靴|あまぐつ}: children's rain boots

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{長靴|ながぐつ}→長靴：17966_nagagutsu⟧: tall rubber boots — named for the height; also worn for farm work and fishing
- ⟦レインコート→レインコート：27700_reinkooto⟧: raincoat
